about: The app's tools, for every AI core: name, label, description and parameters (JSON Schema), as the model sees them.
set: which sessions get it (ToolCatalog.forSession): phone = phone sessions; bash = sessions with Termux;
send_file = sessions with Termux in a messaging app; supervisor = the supervisor.
parallel: the core may run several calls of it at once (else one at a time).
A core declares these and sends each call to the app's "tool" host call (ToolRouter), which runs it.

tools.name: open_app
tools.label: Open app
tools.description: Open an installed app by its name or package name, e.g. "Gmail" or "com.google.android.gm".

tools.name: read_screen
tools.label: Read screen
tools.description: Read what is on the screen now: one line per element, `[id] Class "text" (description) flags @x,y` (@x,y is the element's centre). Ids are valid until the next screen you get. Every action already returns the screen it leaves, so you rarely need this.

tools.name: tap
tools.label: Tap
tools.description: Tap the element with this id from the latest screen.

tools.name: tap_at
tools.label: Tap at
tools.description: Tap a screen point (pixels, as in read_screen's @x,y or a screenshot scaled to the screen size). Use when read_screen has no element for what you need.

tools.name: long_press
tools.label: Long press
tools.description: Long-press the element with this id (e.g. to open a context menu).

tools.name: swipe
tools.label: Swipe
tools.description: Swipe across the screen like a finger. "up" reveals content further down (scrolls a feed down), "down" goes back up, "left"/"right" for carousels and tabs. fraction = share of the screen (0.2-0.8, default 0.6). Works where scroll does not (many feeds don't report themselves scrollable).

tools.name: screenshot
tools.label: Screenshot
tools.description: See the screen as an image (scaled down; multiply coordinates by the factor given). Use it when read_screen misses things: images, prices drawn as pictures, videos, custom-drawn lists. Prefer read_screen for text and ids.

tools.name: type_text
tools.label: Type text
tools.description: Replace the text of an editable element (from the latest read_screen) with the given text. submit: true then presses Enter, as the keyboard's Enter / Go / Search key does: e.g. to open a URL typed into a browser's address bar, or to search. Some apps (WeChat) hide their screen, so read_screen lists no field: then tap_at the field (find it in a screenshot) and call type_text without id; it puts the text (any language) at the cursor of the focused field. Check with a screenshot, then tap_at the app's Send button.

tools.name: scroll
tools.label: Scroll
tools.description: Scroll a scrollable element (or the first scrollable one if id is omitted) forward (down) or backward (up).

tools.name: press_key
tools.label: Press key
tools.description: Press a key: back, home, recents, or enter (submits the focused text field, like the keyboard's Enter / Go / Search key).

tools.name: wait
tools.label: Wait
tools.description: Wait (milliseconds, max 5000) when something is still loading. Actions already wait for the screen to settle.

tools.name: note
tools.label: Note
tools.description: Write down facts from the current screen that you will need later (an email's sender, subject, dates and asks; an item's price and rating). Only the latest two screens stay visible to you; your notes stay for the whole task.

tools.name: bash
tools.label: Bash (Termux)
tools.description: Run a bash command in Termux, a Linux environment on this phone (aarch64, Termux packages, no root, no Docker). Starts in this session's own folder (~/sessions/<session>), which keeps files between calls; there is no /tmp, use $TMPDIR. Install tools with `pkg install -y <pkg>` (e.g. curl, jq, python, golang, git, tmux). Returns the exit code, stdout and stderr (long output is cut in the middle). Times out after timeout seconds (default 120, max 600); for servers and long jobs use tmux.

command.description: The bash command or script to run

timeout.description: Seconds before the command is killed (default 120, max 600)

tools.name: send_file
tools.label: Send file
tools.description: Send a file from Termux to the user's chat: a picture, chart, PDF, audio, video or any file up to 50 MB (images up to 10 MB are shown as photos). The path is relative to this session's folder, or absolute.

path.description: The file's path in Termux, e.g. chart.png or ~/sessions/<id>/out/report.pdf

caption.description: A short caption shown with it

tools.name: list_sessions
tools.label: List sessions
tools.description: All sessions (most recent first): id, kind (phone = operates the phone in its own screen; chat = talks only), status (Running, Queued, Paused, Idle, Interrupted), title, the app it uses, and its last line.

tools.name: get_session
tools.label: Read a session
tools.description: One session in detail: status, its latest answer or error, and its recent steps. Use it to collect a session's result.

id.description: Session id (from list_sessions or create_session), or its exact title

tools.name: create_session
tools.label: Start a session
tools.description: Start a new session working on a task, and return its id at once (it runs in the background). phone = true if the task needs to operate apps on the phone (each phone session gets a screen of its own and runs alongside the others); false for pure questions. Write the task as complete, self-contained instructions: the session knows nothing else.

title.description: Short title for the session list

tools.name: message_session
tools.label: Message a session
tools.description: Send a session a follow-up message or a new task (it must not be working; wait_for it first). Use it to pass one session's result to another.

id.description: Session id (from list_sessions or create_session), or its exact title

tools.name: wait_for
tools.label: Wait for sessions
tools.description: Wait until the given sessions have finished their current tasks (or timeout_seconds, at most 600), then return their status and results. Use it to coordinate: wait for one, then give its result to another.

tools.name: pause_session
tools.label: Pause a session
tools.description: Pause a working session: it holds before its next action, until resumed.

id.description: Session id (from list_sessions or create_session), or its exact title

tools.name: resume_session
tools.label: Resume a session
tools.description: Resume a paused session, or continue an Interrupted one (the app was restarted mid-task).

id.description: Session id (from list_sessions or create_session), or its exact title

tools.name: stop_session
tools.label: Stop a session
tools.description: Stop a session's current task (the conversation is kept and can go on later).

id.description: Session id (from list_sessions or create_session), or its exact title

tools.name: delete_session
tools.label: Delete a session
tools.description: Delete a session and its conversation for good. The user is asked to confirm on screen; if they decline, it stays.

id.description: Session id (from list_sessions or create_session), or its exact title

tools.name: rename_session
tools.label: Rename a session
tools.description: Give a session a clearer title.

id.description: Session id (from list_sessions or create_session), or its exact title
